acceptance: morize-core exports MemoryAction from one new decision module with exactly Store, Update, Merge, Supersede, Contradict, Expire, Forget, Redact, Quarantine, Ignore, and RequireReview and no additional current action.
MemoryAction is a closed vocabulary for this Grain: it is not marked non_exhaustive and defines no additional variant; future action-set evolution/version binding is explicitly outside this Grain.
Every MemoryAction variant is fieldless, and no action value grants authorization, mutation authority, target selection, storage effects, or side effects.
MemoryAction supports Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash; focused tests exercise all 11 variants and confirm distinct value semantics without defining an ordering contract.

The implementation defines no action-set version mapping, DecisionEnvelope, MutationIntent, reason code, confidence/abstention semantics, thresholds, engine identity, authorization behavior, FORGET/REDACT behavior, Display, FromStr, parser, serde, numeric repr/discriminants, or wire/persistence format.
cargo fmt --all -- --check passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings passes on the exact implementation head.
cargo test --workspace --all-targets --offline passes and includes focused tests for all 11 memory actions and required value semantics.
Cargo manifests and Cargo.lock are unchanged; the Grain admits no runtime, build, or test dependency.
GitHub Actions passes Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows on the exact implementation head before acceptance.

An independent semantic reviewer reviews the exact implementation head for exact action fidelity, closed-vocabulary correctness, absence of authority/side-effect/version/wire semantics, scope containment, and required evidence.
ADR-0004 proof prerequisite for SG-000011 revalidates against the exact WorkPacket baseline before execution.
The implementation changes no path outside crates/morize-core/src/decision.rs and crates/morize-core/src/lib.rs.

method.control: Implementation is limited to one dependency-free closed in-memory MemoryAction enum, focused tests, and morize-core re-exports. No action-set version identifier, DecisionEnvelope, parser, mutation execution, authorization, threshold, serialization, persistence, or third-party dependency is authorized.
method.review_separation: An independent semantic reviewer must review the exact implementation head, exact 11-action fidelity, closed-vocabulary correctness, absence of mutation authority/version/wire semantics, scope containment, and required evidence separately from the implementing agent before acceptance.
method.rollback: Revert the memory-action implementation commits; no persisted format, action-set version binding, authorization rule, mutation side effect, or user data depends on this Grain.

minimality.rationale: A single standard-library-only closed enum inside existing morize-core is the narrowest implementation of the repository-fixed initial durable-memory action vocabulary. It defers action-set version binding, envelopes, authority, execution, serialization, and persistence.

requirements: MemoryAction values, including Forget and Redact, are descriptive typed decision vocabulary only in this Grain and must not confer authorization, select a target, or execute any mutation or side effect.

outcome: morize-core exposes one dependency-free closed MemoryAction enum for the 11 initial durable-memory actions already fixed by docs/TYPED_DECISION_MODEL.md and docs/DATA_MODEL.md, without defining action-set version identifiers, decision envelopes, mutation authority, authorization, serialization, persistence, or side effects.
rationale: P1 requires a typed decision envelope, and the repository already fixes a closed initial durable-memory action vocabulary. This Grain adds only the typed in-memory action vocabulary so later versioned action-set and DecisionEnvelope contracts can reuse one bounded definition without inventing authority or wire semantics.

risk.recovery: Revert the memory-action implementation commits; no persisted format, action-set version binding, authorization rule, mutation side effect, or user data has been written by this Grain.

scope_in: Define public MemoryAction with exactly the 11 initial durable-memory actions fixed by docs/TYPED_DECISION_MODEL.md and docs/DATA_MODEL.md: Store, Update, Merge, Supersede, Contradict, Expire, Forget, Redact, Quarantine, Ignore, and RequireReview.

Keep the current MemoryAction vocabulary closed in this Grain: no non_exhaustive marker and no additional action variant; future action-set evolution/version binding requires a separate compatibility-governed Grain.

Keep every action fieldless and derive only Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, and Hash so the vocabulary is typed without defining ordering, authority, side effects, thresholds, textual/numeric encoding, transport, or persistence semantics.
Add standard-library-only focused tests that exercise all 11 actions, prove they are distinct hashable values, and prove Copy behavior without textual or numeric encoding.
scope_out: Action-set version identifiers or mappings, DecisionEnvelope/DecisionId composition, candidate references, reason codes, confidence, abstention, thresholds, engine identity, policy revision binding, or decision replay semantics.

MutationIntent construction, authorization, target selection, mutation execution, storage effects, lifecycle transitions, FORGET/REDACT behavior, or any authority-bearing interpretation of an action value.

Display/FromStr, parsers, unknown-action wire validation, serde or other serialization integration, numeric repr/discriminants, persisted or wire encoding, configuration formats, migrations, storage, retrieval, or domain-record integration.
Any third-party runtime, build, or test dependency.
